detail.longDescription: RE: https:// social.treehouse.systems/@aria dne/117579594140229264 Woof... There's no shortage of kool-aide drinkers out there, eh? If your unwavering willingness to defend the blatantly exploitative AI industry goes so far that you can no longer stick the landing on your mental gymnastics routine, and end up boldly proclaiming support for fucking slavery... you probably need to log off and spent some time looking inward. (And that's frankly pretty fucking generous.) People who develop technology have a responsibility and duty to consider the ethical and social implications of that technology. We can't afford to be stupid and myopic about how we approach all of this stuff. We can't afford to continue living in a new dark age of ethics where the ends always seem to justify the means. # technology # ethics # linux # foss # gnu # programming # ai
